dedupe_keys.name: figaro inter country supply use and input output tables

description: FIGARO (Full International and Global Accounts for Research in input-Output analysis) tables are the European Union's inter-country supply, use and input-output tables, published by Eurostat. They cover 64 industries by NACE Revision 2 and 64 products by CPA 2.1, with supply, use, industry-by-industry and product-by-product input-output tables and direct purchases abroad, for the years 2010 to 2024, together with applications and indicators on trade, such as imports and exports by industry. Data, user instructions and worked examples are in the FIGARO space of the Commission's CIRCABC platform: CSV files in flat and matrix layouts for all tables, Excel pivot tables for the 21-industry input-output tables, summary tables in Excel, and detailed data in Parquet. Access is free. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (European Commission reuse policy: EU-owned content under CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted). Caveats: the tables are estimates that combine national accounts with trade statistics, and countries outside the EU are represented in less detail. For simulation it gives the inter-industry and inter-country network of the EU economy for supply-chain disruption, input-output impact and resilience analyses. Related catalogue records include the World Input-Output Database, EXIOBASE and Eora2.
